answer: The prism schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the garden checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 45 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. Someone wanting 107 effective identities must lock that capital for 45 epochs and keep it locked through every quartz audit. That is 22 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
